summary: SAMSON Beta Operations Center — full backend + frontend testing on Emergent preview. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass (bug reports, suggestions, validation, admin counts, CSV export with kind filters, 401 without auth). Frontend /beta page renders correctly: hero title/version 1.0.13/build 19/badge, 6 checklist items with localStorage persistence under 'samson_beta_checklist_v1', 6 FAQ toggles with single-open behavior, contact mailto link, bug report + suggestion forms submit successfully and clear on success. No console errors/warnings. Mobile 375x812 responsive render OK.
critical_code_review_comments: beta.py opens its own MongoClient in module scope (routes/beta.py line 33) instead of reusing the shared client in server.py — minor duplication but works.
BetaOps.jsx is 606 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting into sub-files (Hero, BugReportForm, SuggestionForm, FAQ, DailyChecklist) for maintainability.

REACT_APP_PLAY_STORE_URL / REACT_APP_BETA_GUIDE_URL / REACT_APP_FEEDBACK_FORM_URL are currently '#' in frontend/.env — Install/Beta Guide/Feedback buttons are inert until the real URLs are set (expected per problem statement, but worth flagging).
Bug report screenshot_link accepts any string up to 500 chars — no URL validation. Acceptable since it's optional, but a simple HttpUrl or regex validator would prevent junk data.
seed_data_creation: Left 2 TEST_ bug reports + 2 TEST_ suggestions in Mongo (plus 1 pre-existing each) so CSV export has data. Well under the 3-per-kind cap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Beta endpoints live at /api/beta/* (bug-reports, suggestions, counts, export.csv). Admin auth via Bearer JWT from /api/auth/login (access_token in response body) OR ?key=BETA_EXPORT_KEY. Mongo collections: beta_bug_reports, beta_suggestions. Frontend at /beta, single-page BetaOps.jsx. All data-testids present and match spec.
